column1: # Claims of docs/concepts/osd-and-notices.md.
element
osd takes full, minimal, off and silent, minimal by default
the four levels, each hiding what the one before it hides
only minimal and full draw status, the brief line included
a change shows the OSD for a time, not under off, silent or never
the full line: a dot, the head's name and the console shown of how many
under full the line shows at a console switch, an open or close, and a display's return
the active head's move shows the OSD on each head with a lit display
osd-timeout is 3 seconds by default, or never
the brief line at a console cap, word for word
under off and silent the open chord at a cap shows no brief line
a notice goes after 30 seconds
a head shows at most 4 notices
the no-keyboard notice, word for word
under silent a head adds no notice
under silent a display no rule places shows no notice and stays off, and the log names it
under silent the display guard lights the boot display only for the panic screen or the stopped notice
under silent the render timer shows no figures on screen
an osd line vtium cannot read beside silent runs as off
the panic screen
the stopped notice, shown under closed after a crash loop
the notice colors
the OSD colors
focus-mark is the older name, read where osd and osd-timeout are unset
